_comment: Curated map of catalogue product id -> the exact Wikimedia Commons file holding a
real photograph of THAT product. Every entry was checked so the photo depicts the
model the catalogue names -- where Commons had no photo of a newer variant, the
catalogue names the variant that is actually pictured rather than mislabelling it.
fetch-assets.mjs resolves each title to a CDN thumbnail and records attribution.
